QuestInfo.name: [Lethe] Slipping Through the Cracks
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p1012111# and ask what you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1:
Defeat each type of Golem and deliver their fragments to #p1012111#. The Golems are located on the following maps:



#m100040100#

#m100040200#

#m100040300#

QuestInfo.2: The Golems became more powerful after the wolves attacked the temple. After giving Bruce the fragments, he noted that there was a strange magic in them.
